Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of fundamental scientific definitions regarding solutions. The Planner incorrectly identified the roles of salt and water, stating that salt is the solvent and water is the solute. In a saltwater mixture, water is the substance doing the dissolving (the solvent) and salt is the substance being dissolved (the solute). This error represents a direct contradiction of established chemical principles, similar to the "Misinterpretation of scientific concepts" pattern seen in Example 2 and Example 5.
